notes: Stories added for Server-Side Scope Enforcement feature.

change_log.note: Expose enforcement behavior through FastAPI/tool loop

stories.title: Define Tool Scope Enforcement Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the contract for tool scope enforcement including allowed tool registry, scope boundaries per request, and validation rules for tool invocation. Ensure compatibility with existing Pydantic tool_models and allowlist dispatch patterns.

stories.title: Implement Server-Side Scope Enforcement in Tool Router
stories.description: Extend tool_router to enforce scope boundaries at runtime by validating each tool call against the allowlist and request-specific scope. Reject or block any tool invocation outside permitted scope before execution.

stories.title: Integrate Scope Enforcement with FastAPI Tool Execution Loop
stories.description: Ensure scope enforcement is applied consistently within the FastAPI request lifecycle and Claude tool-use loop in main.py, including proper error handling and user-safe responses when violations occur.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Scope Enforcement
stories.description: Create tests validating that allowed tools execute successfully and out-of-scope tools are rejected. Include edge cases such as malformed tool calls and bypass attempts. Extend existing test_tool_router coverage.
